data.rationale: time_before wraps time_less_ and needs this postcondition to prove its own result specification about comparing timeabs structures.

time_after needs to establish its postcondition relating the result to the comparison of timespec members. This postcondition from time_greater_ directly enables proving that time_after returns true iff a.ts > b.ts.
